revision_note: Before the final run, the local audit identified 1,204 zero-volume candles across 602 OOS symbol-sessions. This version excludes any zero-volume candle and the entire affected or otherwise incomplete regular symbol-session; strategy parameters are unchanged. This leaves no retained full symbol-sessions after 2026-07-31 in the requested OOS window, so August–October 2026 is absent from the results. An earlier diagnostic run is superseded.

partitions.status: Stage 9/10 evaluated; not an untouched holdout

execution.signal_timing: Completed signal candle; enter at the next same-session five-minute candle open.
execution.stop_handling: Check each holding candle low; gap through stop fills at candle open; otherwise stop price.
execution.session_exit: Close at final valid same-session candle; never carry overnight.
execution.gap_policy: Reject events whose required feature, entry, or holding window contains a same-session gap or incomplete session tail.
execution.intrabar_ambiguity: Stop is the only intrabar exit; stop takes precedence when touched.

cost_assumptions.slippage: 5 bps adverse per side, modeled; not measured

data_policy.timestamp_assumption: Treat source labels provisionally as candle starts; original dataset-specific label semantics remain unresolved.
data_policy.session_policy: Use only dates marked VERIFIED and REGULAR in manifest v2; exclude special, holiday, unresolved, absent, out-of-session, and out-of-alignment rows.

data_policy.malformed_ohlc: Exclude structurally invalid rows via app.candle_integrity; signal and holding windows with resulting same-session gaps are rejected.
data_policy.session_coverage: Require all 75 aligned regular-session START labels from 09:15 through 15:25 for each symbol-date; exclude incomplete symbol-sessions rather than bridging missing bars.
data_policy.zero_volume: Any zero-volume equity candle makes its symbol-session incomplete; exclude the entire symbol-session. Volume-field meaning remains unresolved.
data_policy.missing_bars: Never fill; reject affected event windows. Require a complete session tail when horizon runs to end of day.
data_policy.corporate_actions_and_survivorship: Unresolved; limits conclusions to this fixed available basket and observed records.

acceptance_criteria: Descriptive only; no statistical or profitability acceptance threshold. Further investigation may be suggested only if net P&L after modeled costs is positive with at least 30 trades overall and positive net P&L in at least two chronological partitions; this is not validation or paper approval.
